name: synccharts
summary: This EA synchronizes all open charts in the terminal to match the active chart's timeframe, scale, scroll position, chart mode, and vertical line objects. It runs on a 200ms timer, continuously propagating the source chart's view settings to every other chart. It does not place any trades or manage positions.
summary_zh: 这个EA将终端中所有打开的图表同步为与当前活跃图表相同的时间周期、缩放比例、滚动位置、图表模式和垂直线对象。它以200毫秒定时器持续运行，将源图表的视图设置传播到其他所有图表。它不进行任何交易或仓位管理。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个图表同步工具。其核心概念是通过定时器每200毫秒检测当前图表的视图状态，包括时间周期、缩放级别、首个可见K线位置、图表模式（蜡烛图/线图等）以及垂直线对象。入场条件不适用，因为没有交易信号逻辑。出场条件同样不适用，因为该EA不管理任何仓位。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在，因为其功能纯粹是UI层面的图表视图同步。策略上，它禁用了自动滚动和偏移功能，确保所有图表保持在相同的滚动位置，并将垂直线对象的属性（颜色、宽度、样式、选中状态）完整复制到其他图表。其设计意图是让交易者在多图表分析时保持视图一致性，方便跨品种或跨周期的视觉对比。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart synchronization utility. Its core concept is to poll the active chart's view state every 200 milliseconds via a timer, capturing timeframe, scale level, first visible bar position, chart mode (candlestick/line etc.), and vertical line objects. Entry conditions are not applicable since there is no trade signal logic. Exit conditions are similarly inapplicable as the EA does not manage any positions. Position sizing and money management are nonexistent because its functionality is purely at the UI level for chart view synchronization. Strategically, it disables auto-scroll and shift features on both the source and target charts, ensuring all charts remain at the same scroll position. It also fully replicates vertical line object properties including color, width, style, and selected state across all other open charts. Its design intent is to let traders maintain view consistency during multi-chart analysis, facilitating visual comparison across instruments or timeframes.

parameters.name: bSyncVLine
parameters.description: 是否同步垂直线对象到其他图表
parameters.description_en: Sync vertical line objects to other charts

pros: 多图表视图同步极大提升了跨品种或跨周期分析的效率，减少手动调整图表的时间
垂直线对象属性完整复制，包括颜色、宽度、样式和选中状态，保留标注细节
定时器机制响应迅速（200ms），视图变化几乎实时同步，用户体验流畅
pros_en: Multi-chart view synchronization greatly improves efficiency for cross-instrument or cross-timeframe analysis, reducing manual chart adjustment time
Vertical line object properties are fully replicated including color, width, style, and selected state, preserving annotation details
Timer mechanism responds quickly (200ms), making view changes nearly real-time and providing a smooth user experience
cons: 每200毫秒遍历所有图表并操作对象，可能造成不必要的性能开销，尤其在图表数量较多时
同步逻辑会强制覆盖目标图表的时间周期设置（ChartSetSymbolPeriod），可能导致用户正在分析的其他周期视图被意外切换
缺乏对目标图表的选择性过滤，无法指定仅同步特定图表或排除某些图表
cons_en: Iterating all charts and manipulating objects every 200ms may cause unnecessary performance overhead, especially with many open charts
The sync logic forcibly overrides target chart timeframe settings via ChartSetSymbolPeriod, potentially disrupting a user's analysis on different timeframes
Lacks selective filtering for target charts — no way to specify only certain charts to sync or exclude specific ones
improvements: 添加目标图表过滤机制，允许用户指定需要同步的图表列表或排除特定图表
优化同步触发机制，使用事件驱动（如OnChartEvent）替代纯定时器轮询，减少不必要的计算开销
improvements_en: Add a target chart filtering mechanism, allowing users to specify a list of charts to sync or exclude specific charts
Optimize the sync trigger mechanism by using event-driven approaches (e.g., OnChartEvent) instead of pure timer polling to reduce unnecessary computational overhead

risk_points: 该EA不进行任何交易操作，不存在资金风险
强制修改其他图表的时间周期和视图设置可能干扰用户正在进行的多周期分析工作流
risk_points_en: This EA does not perform any trading operations, posing no financial risk
Forcibly modifying other charts' timeframe and view settings may disrupt a user's ongoing multi-timeframe analysis workflow
